GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 230.32 (26 Dec 45) GS
(SCAPIN-503)
26 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Promotion of Civil Service Officials.
In reference to the request contained in CLO No. 1015 (1.1) subject as above dated 11 Decerber 1945 you are advised.
1. That hereafter the phrase "Chosen Government-General" will not be used as a part of the name of any agency, bureau, branch, section or unit of the Imperial Japanese Government.
2. That Memorandum AG 210.2 (2 Oct 45) MG does not apply to the officials mentioned in CLC No. 1015 (1.1) 11 Dec 45.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel,A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
